title: Anagram Grouping & Canonical Sorting
statement: Given an array of N lowercase strings, group the anagrams together. Sort each group lexicographically, and then sort all groups by the first word in each group. Output each group on a new line separated by spaces.
input_format: The first line contains N. The next line contains N space-separated strings.
output_format: Print each group of anagrams on a new line.
sample_input:
6
eat tea tan ate nat bat
sample_output:
ate eat tea
bat
nat tan
